name: Paladin Archon of Grace
body:
An archon of grace is a champion that guides their allies to victory with hearts full of conviction and they dampen the might of chaos and evil to safeguard the weak.

Heavenly Auras

At 1st level, an archon of grace is gifted with the blessings of the manifold heavens in the form of projected auras, made possible by their own willpower and insights. This ability functions as the marshal’s minor auras (including determining the aura bonus), except as described here. The archon of grace’s effective marshal level for this ability is equal to their paladin class levels for all purposes of this ability (including stacking with the marshal class to determine the aura bonus).

Unlike a marshal, all of an archon of grace’s heavenly auras apply either a sacred penalty on enemies or a sacred bonus on allies, including the archon of grace as described below. An archon of grace’s effective marshal level is equal to their paladin class levels for all purposes of this class feature, including stacking with the marshal class to determine total number of readied auras per day. If a heavenly aura applies a sacred penalty on an archon of grace’s enemies, an enemy can suppress the sacred penalty affecting them for one round if they succeed on a Will save DC 10 + 1/2 the archon of grace’s paladin class levels + their Charisma modifier at the start of their turn.

All of the archon of grace’s heavenly auras are listed in this section.

Heavenly Auras
Blessed Aim: Affected allies add the aura bonus as a sacred bonus to their attack rolls made while flanking and on rolls made to confirm critical hits.
Fortunes Reversed: Affected enemies apply the aura bonus as a sacred penalty to their AC against attacks of opportunity and on their attack rolls made as part of an attack of opportunity.
Good Hope: Affected allies increase their effective HD by an amount equal to the aura bonus for the purposes of determining whether or not they are affected by a fear effect and to determine the DC required to intimidate them.
Heavenly Guidance: Affected allies add the aura bonus as a sacred bonus on their combat maneuver checks and to their combat maneuver defense.
Holy Tactics: Affected enemies apply the aura bonus as a sacred penalty to their damage rolls while flanking or charging.
Holy Vitality: Affected allies heal hit points damage each round equal to the aura bonus at the start of their turn as long as their current hit points is equal to or less than 1/3 their maximum hit points. Any attack on an affected ally that inflicts hit points damage will automatically suppress the effects of holy vitality on that ally for one round.
Proficiency: Affected allies add the aura bonus to reduce the total non-proficiency penalties for armor and weapons. This cannot reduce the penalty below 0. This bonus may be spread over multiple weapons and armor if applicable.
Purifying Sin: Affected enemies apply the aura bonus as a sacred penalty to their Fortitude and Reflex saves.
Sacred Diversion: Affected enemies apply the aura bonus as a sacred penalty as a reduction to their ranged attacks rolls outside of their 1st range increment. This penalty cannot exceed the penalty from range penalties.
Springtime of Youth: When readied, an archon of grace chooses an ability score and when active this heavenly aura adds the aura bonus as a sacred bonus on all affected allies to all of their skill checks made with that ability score. This aura may be readied multiple times, choosing a different ability score for each.
Strengthened Spirit: Affected allies add the aura bonus as a sacred bonus on their Will saves and concentration checks. This ability replaces smite evil gained at 1st, 4th, and 7th levels, and aura of courage.

Blessed Hands

At 2nd level, an archon of grace learns from the whispered guidance of holy creatures. This ability functions as the paladin’s lay on hands except that it cannot be used to harm undead creatures. Instead, it can only harm creatures with the chaotic or evil subtype. This ability is otherwise identical to and counts as lay on hands for all purposes, including meeting prerequisites and using the paladin’s mercies.

This ability alters lay on hands.

Exemplar of Grace and Benevolence

At 4th level, an archon of grace may now have any two auras active. At 11th level and again at 19th level, the number of auras an archon of grace can have active increases by 1, to a maximum of 4 active auras at 19th level.

This ability replaces channel energy, aura of resolve, and aura of righteousness.

Auras of Consecration

At 10th level, the tenets of the heavens reveal deeper insights in the essence of good and protection. This ability functions as the marshal’s major auras except as described here. An archon of grace’s auras of consecration either imposes a sacred penalty on enemies or a sacred bonus on allies as described below. The archon of grace’s effective marshal level is equal to their paladin class levels. Unlike the heavenly auras, a sacred penalty imposed by an aura of consecration on an archon of grace’s enemies cannot be suppressed with a Will save.

Blessed Weapons: Affected allies increase the critical threat range of their weapons by 1/3 (minimum 1) the aura bonus. This does not stack with the increases provided by any other effects.
Boosted Movement: Affected allies increase all of their move speeds by a number of feet equal to five times the aura bonus. This is treated as an enhancement bonus. If this increase in speed is equal to or more than double an affected ally’s highest movement speed, that ally can make one additional attack per round at their highest BAB whenever they make a full attack. This does not stack with the haste spell or similar effects that grants an additional attack. An affected ally can only make this additional attack a number of times per day equal to the archon of grace’s Charisma modifier.
Greater Holy Tactics: This aura replaces holy tactics and applies the aura bonus as a sacred penalty to affected enemies on all weapon damage rolls.
Greater Holy Vitality: This aura replaces holy vitality. The affected allies still heal the same amount of hit points damage as holy vitality at the start of their turn but the healing now persists for an additional 3 rounds if the affected ally leaves the range of this aura. Furthermore, the effects of this aura apply as long as the affected ally’s current hit points is equal to or less than 1/2 their maximum hit points. Finally, only chaoticaligned and evil-aligned attacks on an affected ally that inflicts hit points damage will automatically suppress the effects of greater holy vitality on that ally for one round.
Guided Reactions: Affected allies add the aura bonus as a sacred bonus to their initiative checks. When this aura is readied, the archon of grace may choose to end another aura and activate this aura as a free action when rolling for initiative.
Sacred Protection: Affected allies add the aura bonus as a sacred bonus to their AC, including touch AC and when flat footed.
Serene Focus: Affected allies add the aura bonus as a sacred bonus on their caster level checks made to overcome spell resistance.
Sheltered Presence: Affected allies add the aura bonus as a reduction to the penalty on using weapons or casting spells while underwater and on penalties related to altitude, and they are not treated as flat-footed while climbing or balancing. Abilities or magical effects that would otherwise automatically impose these penalties (such as being trapped within a magical breathable liquid) or treat the ally as flat-footed while climbing or balancing functions as normal if the source is 4+ levels higher than the archon of grace.
Shield of Heaven: Affected allies reduce the total amount of hit points damage suffered from any source by an amount equal to the aura bonus; this reduction is applied last after all other effects that reduce the total damage suffered. This aura’s effects stack with DR and energy resistance if applicable.
Will of the Heavens: When readying this aura, the archon of grace chooses from among acid, cold, electricity, fire, negative energy, or positive energy. This aura reduces the energy resistance of all affected enemies for the chosen energy type equal to five times the aura bonus. If the affected enemy has energy immunity to the chosen energy type, this aura treats their energy immunity as energy resistance 50 before being reduced by will of the heavens. This aura may be readied multiple times, choosing a different energy type for each. This ability replaces smite evil gained at 10th level and aura of justice.
Sacred World: At 13th level, the range of all of an archon of grace’s auras increase to 100 feet (if applicable). This ability replaces smite evil gained at 13th, 16th, and 19th levels.
Avatar of Grace and Protection

At 20th level, an archon of grace becomes a conduit for the might of the heavens and myriad realms. They gain DR 5/–. Whenever a creature confirms a critical hit against an archon of grace, that creature is struck with myriad energies, dealing an additional 1d6 points of damage each from acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic, and positive energy (energy resistance and immunity to energy applies as normal). This additional damage is not multiplied on a critical hit. Additionally, whenever an archon of grace uses blessed hands to heal hit points damage, they heal the maximum possible amount of damage and the target creature is affected with a shield of faith spell (CL equals the archon of grace’s paladin class levels) for 1 minute.

This ability replaces holy champion at 20th level.
